Name: LiteSic
ShortDescription: Your local music, playlists and a 10-band equalizer in a native Windows player.
Description:
Listen to your local music collection with LiteSic, a native Windows player with direct controls and three panels: playback, equalizer and playlist.

Open MP3, WAV, FLAC and OGG Vorbis files, add folders and organize your tracks with search, sorting and favorites. Import and export M3U/M3U8 playlists and restore your list when you reopen the app.

Adjust your sound with a 10-band equalizer, preamplification and presets. Control volume and balance, choose shuffle or repeat, and follow the music through an audio spectrum or oscilloscope.

Customize the appearance with themes, interface scaling and panels that snap together. The interface is available in Brazilian Portuguese, English and other languages.

LiteSic is free, with no ads, in-app purchases or subscriptions. No account is required. It plays local files without a streaming service. No music is included with the app.
Features: Local MP3, WAV, FLAC and OGG Vorbis playback
File and folder playlists with search, sorting and favorites
M3U/M3U8 import and export and session restoration
Volume, balance, shuffle and repeat controls
Themes, adjustable interface scale and snapping panels
Brazilian Portuguese, English and other interface languages
ReleaseNotes: First version prepared for the Microsoft Store. Local playback, playlists, favorites, equalizer, visualizer and interface customization.
Requirements: Windows 10 version 1809 (build 17763) or later; x86 or x64 processor; an audio output device and supported local audio files. This preparation was tested on Windows 11. The traditional distribution has its own requirements and validation scope.
